title: good_honker
description: Ask Claude about Goose shows: setlists, jams, venues, song history. Live from ElGoose.net.
summary: Ask Claude about Goose shows: setlists, jams, venues, song history. Live from ElGoose.net.

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Health check and a manifest of what good_honker can do.

toolsPreview.name: get_setlist
toolsPreview.description: Goose setlist for a given date (YYYY-MM-DD).

toolsPreview.name: this_day_in_history
toolsPreview.description: Every show played on a given calendar day (month 1-12, day 1-31), across years.

toolsPreview.name: search_shows
toolsPreview.description: Find shows by year, city, state, and/or venue name.

toolsPreview.name: random_show
toolsPreview.description: A random Goose show, with its full setlist.

toolsPreview.name: song_history
toolsPreview.description: Every time a song has been played (most recent first).

toolsPreview.name: song_stats
toolsPreview.description: Summary stats for a song: times played, debut, last played, jamchart count.

toolsPreview.name: jam_chart
toolsPreview.description: Notable jams from the ElGoose jam charts, optionally filtered to one song.

toolsPreview.name: venue_info
toolsPreview.description: Venue metadata plus how many times Goose has played there.

toolsPreview.name: upcoming_shows
toolsPreview.description: Announced upcoming shows (dates on or after today).

toolsPreview.name: album_info
toolsPreview.description: Goose discography: list albums, or the tracklist of one album.

toolsPreview.name: appearances
toolsPreview.description: Guest sit-ins / musician appearances, optionally filtered to one person.

toolsPreview.name: show_extras
toolsPreview.description: Poster art, images, and external links attached to a show on a given date.
